novel_features.name: Merge-field upsert from CSV
novel_features.description: Take a raw CSV export and merge-upsert it straight into an Airtable table, matched on the field you choose.
novel_features.rationale: Requires header-to-field mapping plus batching into Airtable's performUpsert.fieldsToMergeOn contract — no other Airtable tool goes straight from CSV to a merge upsert.
novel_features.example: airtable-pp-cli records upsert-csv --base appLkNDICXNqxSDhG --table Leads --file leads.csv --merge-on Email
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this whenever the input is a CSV export from another system and existing rows should be updated instead of duplicated.

novel_features.name: Local diff before bulk write
novel_features.description: See exactly which fields on which existing records would change before a bulk update or upsert actually runs.
novel_features.rationale: Fetches current live field values for each target record ID and diffs them field-by-field against a proposed payload, something no live 'would create N records' dry-run shows.
novel_features.example: airtable-pp-cli records diff --base appLkNDICXNqxSDhG --table Shipments --stdin < changes.json
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before any agent-authored bulk update to confirm what will actually change, not just how many rows will be touched.

novel_features.name: Cross-base full-text search
novel_features.description: Search text across every synced base and table at once from one local index.
novel_features.rationale: Builds an FTS index over the flattened fields JSON of every record synced via 'records sync-table' — Airtable's REST API has no cross-base search endpoint.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this instead of iterating records list per table when the query might match any base or table already synced locally.

novel_features.name: Schema drift detection
novel_features.description: Show exactly what changed in a base's schema since the last time this command ran for that base.
novel_features.rationale: Diffs the last-stored local schema snapshot against a fresh live schema pull, field-by-field, instead of forcing a full manual re-read.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Run before deploying pipeline changes that depend on a base's field names or types staying stable.

narrative.headline: Airtable REST API CLI with offline cross-base search, CSV merge-upserts, field-level diffs before bulk writes, and schema drift detection.
narrative.value_prop: Airtable's wrappers are libraries, and its official MCP is an online-only tool surface without delete, comments, webhooks, attachments, or a local store. This CLI mirrors your bases into local SQLite for full-text search across every base at once, runs CSV-to-merge-upserts, shows field-level diffs before bulk writes, and serves the whole API to agents over stdio or HTTP MCP.
narrative.auth_narrative: Create a Personal Access Token at airtable.com/create/tokens with the scopes you need (for example data.records:read, data.records:write, schema.bases:read) and the specific bases or workspaces it should reach. Set it as AIRTABLE_API_KEY, or store it with the auth commands. This CLI authenticates with personal access tokens only.

quickstart.comment: Bulk-sync a CSV export straight into Airtable with merge-field upsert semantics

troubleshoots.fix: Airtable enforces 5 req/s per base and 50 req/s per token; wait 30s before retrying, the client backs off automatically but persistent 429s mean too much concurrent traffic against one base.

Both the user AND the token need access: check that the token has the base added as a resource and the required scope (e.g. data.records:write), and that your user account is a collaborator on the base.

troubleshoots.symptom: bases list returns an empty array despite having access
troubleshoots.fix: On Enterprise plans this usually means an org-level 'Block API access to organization-owned apps & workspaces' setting is restricting the token; check Enterprise/org-unit Integrations settings.
CSV header names must exactly match Airtable field names (or field IDs); rerun bases get-schema to see the exact field names for the target table.

troubleshoots.symptom: search / analytics / --expand-links return nothing for a table
troubleshoots.fix: Those commands only see data synced by 'records sync-table --base <id> --table <name>'; run it for that table first.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI for scripted or agent-driven Airtable workflows: bulk record sync from CSV/external systems, cross-base reporting and search, schema change monitoring across many bases, and any automation that outgrew a no-code tool's per-task limits.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI to build or edit Airtable's visual interface layer (Interface Designer) — that requires the Interface Extensions SDK.
Do not use this CLI for real-time collaborative editing inside the Airtable UI — writes here are one-shot API calls, not live cursor-synced edits.
Do not use this CLI for record revision/activity history — that endpoint is Enterprise-only and not exposed here.
Do not use this CLI to write Airtable automations/scripting-block code — that's the separate Scripting API surface.
